svg.title: Blue Blade Eyes — Edge of Sapphire. Draft 3 / Ice classification / forked tree.
svg.desc: 10 skills, 4 purchases, one Advanced Art maximum. Sapphire Edge forks into Honed Crescent then Stroke That Splits Stone, or Frostbitten Grip then Numb to the Marrow. Unblinking Sapphire forks into Hoarfrost Bulwark then Glacier Does Not Yield, or Thirst of the Frost then Winter Takes Its Due. No paths converge. Bonuses affect existing supported tags on Ice-classified Blue Blade Eyes jutsu.

Increase Damage Taken (35% on Sapphire Command, Blade Resonance, Arctic Frost) and the single Decrease Damage Given row (30% on Icebound Might's AOE circle) are the Control trait's rows and the secondary. Decrease Damage Taken sits only on the two ungated 40 AP casts (Quintessential Flake, Sapphire Command, 35% each) and Lifesteal only on Arctic Frost (40%), so guard and drain are the tertiary routes. Departures: Foundations pair by weapon. Sapphire Edge (IDG + DDG) roots the Gaze power (Honed Crescent \u2192 Stroke That Splits Stone) and suppression (Frostbitten Grip \u2192 Numb to the Marrow) routes; Unblinking Sapphire (IDT + DDT on ungated Sapphire Command) roots guard and drain. Lifesteal replaces Afterburn (no Afterburn rows); DDT (two rows) and gated DDG capstones sit under Taiyo's.","Calibration by coverage: Damage +2/+3 (max +5): all five Ice rows are gated and only three (Gaze) or two (Blue Blade) are castable per weapon, so +5 on the castable set matches Taiyo's +5 on three ungated rows; that castable-count discount is how D5(b) is applied. IDG/IDT glue only (+2 Foundation, +3 capstone secondary; max +5). DDT +2/+3/+3 = +8 on two ungated rows (43%). DDG +2/+3/+4 = +9 on one gated AOE row (39%), under Taiyo's +10 per D5(b). Lifesteal +3/+5 = +8 on one gated row (48%).","Item gates (D5): six of eight jutsu need The Threefold Gaze (Icebound Might, Glacial Volley, Ice Shackles) or The Blue Blade (Blade Resonance, Blue Crimson, Arctic Frost); both are HAND-slot weapons (41_INDEX_item.json), not keystones; dual wielding was not read at the pin. Castable rows: Gaze = Damage 3, IDG 2, DDG 1, IDT 1, DDT 2; Blue Blade = Damage 2, IDG 3, IDT 3, DDT 2, Lifesteal 1; no weapon = IDG 1, IDT 1, DDT 2. The ungated jutsu are buffs: no attack without a weapon.","Resolver: the 25% + 0.15/level IDG passive multiplies enhanced Damage rows downstream. Nine of eleven buff/debuff rows have a stat filter but no element, so getEfficiencyRatio (SOURCE_MECHANICS \u00a73) matches them to every element-less hit and to elemental hits of a listed stat type; they act on Ice hits, normal jutsu, weapons and basic attacks alike. Blade Resonance IDT and Arctic Frost IDG carry Earth/Ice/None/Water/Wind. IDG/IDT/DDG/DDT skip pierce; lifesteal includes it.","Delivery: cooldown 7 on every jutsu; damage casts cost 60 AP, the rest 40 AP; percentage rows live the 2 rounds after the cast (\u00a73b), so Glacial Volley's and Blue Crimson's own IDG never boosts their own hit. Quintessential Flake targets EMPTY_GROUND, but its guard and damage buff are SELF rows realized on the caster at cast, not through the tile (actions.ts 980-1004); only the unsupported move row is tile-based. Icebound Might's Damage row (friendly fire none = ALL) is the one ally-hazard row.","Fourth purchases: Burst adds Unblinking Sapphire or Frostbitten Grip; Suppression adds Unblinking Sapphire or Honed Crescent; Bulwark adds Sapphire Edge or Thirst of the Frost; Drain adds Hoarfrost Bulwark or Sapphire Edge. All 14 allocations are non-dominated; every node is used. Strongest unadvertised by row weight (39): Sapphire Edge, Honed Crescent, Frostbitten Grip, Numb to the Marrow; Stroke That Splits Stone + Frostbitten Grip is the strongest unadvertised Damage build."],"risks":["Classification: Ice is not exclusive: Hyouga Yui and Teno Yuki (INCLUDE), Blue Edge Eyes (EXCLUDE) and five DEFER records carry Ice rows; the normal-jutsu collision is unverified. Today 7 of 16 supported rows match Ice directly and 9 fall back to None, which also reaches non-elemental rows on any jutsu. The tree assumes a bloodline-scoped classification and is inert or leaky without it.","Item gates: 12 of 16 supported rows need The Threefold Gaze or The Blue Blade (HAND-slot weapons). All Damage, DDG and Lifesteal rows are gated: Burst gets +5 on three rows (Gaze) or two (Blue Blade), Suppression needs the Gaze, Drain the Blue Blade; only Bulwark is fully ungated. If both can be wielded at once (not read at the pin), all five Damage rows are live; trim the capstone to +2.","Ally hazard: Icebound Might row 0 (Damage, AOE_CIRCLE_SPAWN, friendly fire none = ALL) hits allies in the circle, never the caster; Honed Crescent and Stroke That Splits Stone raise that to 42/45 for allies inside. Blue Crimson's Damage row is ENEMIES-only (its wound row is unsupported). Sapphire Command's exposure row (friendly fire none, single target) exposes an ally at 37\u201340% if cast on one.","IDG stacking: four self rows reach 40% each at the route maximum and all stack (process.ts 1109-1117). Blue Crimson, Arctic Frost and Quintessential Flake (Blue Blade, 140 AP) timed to share a round add 120% of the staged base to matching hits; all four (dual-wield, 200 AP) add 160%; the 28.75% passive then multiplies. Flats held at +5; the normal-tree combined total is a roster-review item.","Lifesteal: Arctic Frost's leech reaches 48% of every hit landed in its two-round window (all four stat types, no element: Ice hits, normal jutsu, weapons and basic attacks qualify; pierce included). It shares the 60%-of-pre-shield-damage budget with vamp; the kit has no vamp row, so other leech saturates after 12 more points. Needs both combatants alive; healprevent on the caster blocks it.","Suppression and guard: DDG is one AOE row on a 60 AP, cooldown-7, Gaze-gated cast (39% at maximum; value scales with enemies inside). DDT is two 35% SELF rows on 40 AP casts, live the two rounds after cast and not tile-bound; cast together or in consecutive rounds they share a round, removing 43% + 43% = 86% of the staged base from matching non-pierce hits, which is why the route stops at +8.","No adverse rows, hidden rows, mode restrictions or injected children exist; the unsupported shield, buffprevent, stun, wound, move and redirection rows are unchanged and pierce is absent. Skill-tree and bloodline effects are suppressed in ranked modes. No combat simulation: non-dominance of the 14 allocations is an arithmetic result over per-row additions, not evidence of equal combat strength.","Rank context: Blue Blade Eyes is an S-rank bloodline with a 28.75% Increase Damage Given passive at jutsu level 25 and a 100 regen bonus; this tree equalises marginal opportunity against the reference, not final strength. Cross-bloodline comparison is deferred to the roster review."],"progression":{"currency":"Bloodright Point","abbreviation":"BP","acquired_with":"silver","acquisition_cap":4,"node_cost":1,"silver_price":null,"ownership_gate":"current bloodline","separate_from_normal_skill_points":true},"evaluation_level":25,"game_source_pin":"16498fd776fad9c91e4b84efed4380fe3a487050","snapshot":{"public_kit_snapshot":"2026-10-01T14:58:45.422376+00:00","hidden_kit_snapshot":"2026-09-30"},"audit":{"available_skills":10,"foundation_count":2,"hidden_art_count":4,"advanced_art_count":4,"bloodright_point_cap":4,"cost_per_skill":1,"maximum_advanced_arts":1,"minimum_two_advanced_cost":5,"maximum_parents_per_node":1,"maximum_depth":3,"legal_allocations_by_size":{"0":1,"1":2,"2":5,"3":10,"4":14},"full_budget_allocations":14,"non_dominated_full_allocations":14,"all_nodes_in_non_dominated_builds":true,"nodes_absent_from_non_dominated_builds":[],"maximum_tag_bonuses":{"damage":5,"increasedamagegiven":5,"decreasedamagegiven":9,"increasedamagetaken":5,"decreasedamagetaken":8,"lifesteal":8},"supported_rows_in_kit":16,"supported_rows_by_tag":{"damage":5,"decreasedamagegiven":1,"decreasedamagetaken":2,"increasedamagegiven":4,"increasedamagetaken":3,"lifesteal":1},"tags_targeted_by_tree":["damage","decreasedamagegiven","decreasedamagetaken","increasedamagegiven","increasedamagetaken","lifesteal"],"supported_tags_in_kit_not_targeted":[],"revision":"Draft 3 / Ice classification / forked tree","source_snapshot":"2026-10-01T14:58:45.422376+00:00","limits":["Proposed potency classification behavior; g.text: Draft 3 / Ice classification / forked tree · Foundations support. Hidden Arts focus. Advanced Arts define.
1 BP each · Acquire points with silver
Every Blue Blade Eyes jutsu: existing supported tags qualify; combat scope stays unchanged.
Finish a path in 3 purchases. Spend your fourth on support or a sibling Hidden Art.
Any two Advanced Arts require at least 5 points. Your limit is 4.
Each skill purchased once · Only your current bloodline unlocks · No converging paths
Examples are choices, not locked presets. Advanced Arts are optional.
Stroke That Splits Stone path + Unblinking Sapphire
Numb to the Marrow path + Unblinking Sapphire
Glacier Does Not Yield path + Sapphire Edge
Winter Takes Its Due path + Hoarfrost Bulwark
IDG: Increase Damage Given · DDG: Decrease Damage Given · IDT: Increase Damage Taken · DDT: Decrease Damage Taken · LS: Lifesteal
FINAL BLUE BLADE EYES TAG VALUES
Jutsu level 25 · main-tree bonuses and bloodline passives excluded
Static bonuses: a 35% tag with +5% becomes 40%. A 40 EP jutsu with +5 Damage becomes 45EP.
Lifesteal shares a 60%-of-hit leech budget with vamp; Reflect returns at most 60% of a hit.
Proposed whole-kit potency classification. Current effect-element matching alone does not provide this inheritance.
14 legal four-skill allocations · 4 Advanced Arts available · Combat tuning remains experimental
